title: The Black Mooring
introNarration: Marram coils a true knot and sets it on the post. "South from the slip is their camp. Defeat the river captain. Then talk marram. One Collegian can square up. A classmate is still wiser. Bring the boats home in your report. I will send otters for the tins."
reminderNarration: "Defeat the river captain in the pirate camp. Then talk marram. Type south from the Otter Slip."
completionNarration: Marram listens, then puts a short boarding oar in your paws. "The landing is a gate. You kept it. Eat in the refectory. The wood is still larger than this river, and the College is still the bright place you come back to."

objectives.label: Reach the Pirate Camp. Type south from the Otter Slip.
Defeat the River Captain in the Pirate Camp.
